tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Grouped content, only when grouping helps (`bg-group`). Live schedule blocks.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed, and the one-shot score-update flash (`bg-hover`).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Control borders: overlay edges, scheduled blocks (`border-control`). 1.9:1 on ink-950, below the 3:1 a meaningful edge needs: interactive edges use `border-field` instead.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text (`fg-disabled`). Below 4.5:1 on ink-950 by design: disabled text carries no information.

tokens.name: chalk-50
tokens.usage: Names, scores, headings (`fg-1`) on ink-950, ink-900 and ink-800.

tokens.name: chalk-100
tokens.usage: Body copy (`fg-2`) on ink-950, ink-900 and ink-800.

tokens.name: chalk-300
tokens.usage: Metadata and the losing side (`fg-3`, `loser`) on ink-950, ink-900 and ink-800.

tokens.name: ball-500
tokens.usage: Primary action and focus ring (`accent`). The logo mark's fill. Actions and selection only.

tokens.name: green-400
tokens.usage: Rating up (`rating-up`) and the success check (`success`).

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Rest period and other neutral timing info (`rest`).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, focus ring, links, selected tab. Never for status, winners, names, scores, ratings, card borders, headings or bullets.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, nav item, tab or filter chip background, with `accent-text`.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: `.live-marker`: static dot + the word "Live". Never pulses, never on a container border.

tokens.name: serving
tokens.usage: `.serve-marker`: the small white ball beside the server.

tokens.name: winner
tokens.usage: Winners get bold weight, not colour.

tokens.name: loser
tokens.usage: The losing side steps down to this.

tokens.name: rating-down
tokens.usage: Rating losses, neutral, always signed with ▼ (`▼ −8`).

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Conflicts on organizer screens: icon + a sentence + a suggested fix.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirmations: text and outline only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation icon in toasts and notices only.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata, labels, the losing side, on `bg-app`, `bg-panel`, `bg-group`.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars, cards (`.fm-card`) and grouped content. Most screens use only `bg-app` and this.

tokens.name: bg-group
tokens.usage: Grouping within a panel; toast and tooltip surface.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows and buttons.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Overlay edges, tooltip edge, scheduled blocks.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: Interactive boundaries: inputs, unchecked checkbox/radio, switch track, secondary buttons (3:1 on ink-900).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your next match is at 19:40. You have 25 minutes to rest.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: Labels are sentence case, 13px, no letter-spacing
styles.usage: Labels: sentence case, no tracking, in `fg-3`.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Current points on the scoring screen. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: scoreboard-display
styles.usage: Surnames on big venue scoreboards and the wordmark only. Not for app headings.

spacing.note: 4px base, chosen per layout: 8–12 within a row, 16–24 between groups, 48–64 between page sections. No unit is a brand rule.

shadow.note: Nothing in the page flow has a shadow. There are no glow tokens.

fontSize.note: Scale 48 / 32 / 24 / 20 / 17 / 15 / 13 / 12, plus the scoring screen's 96. Minimum 12px anywhere.

tokens.name: lh-normal
tokens.usage: Body copy and the page default.
